_: How each preview.jpg is staged. `track` is the state pushed to every bundle, `cover` the two stops of the generated album art (no real album is used — a preview ships in the app and on the web), `backdrop` the gallery ground, matched to _dev/make-previews.py's backdrop(). `playerState` 3 = paused, so the transport shows a play glyph rather than a pause one. A widget only appears here once its preview is rendered from the real bundle; everything absent is still one of the drawn PIL impressions.
